notes.title: Discover the Enchanted Realms: Rising Mist Update Unleashed!
notes.notes:
[b]Attention, brave adventurers of Rising Mist![/b]

We're delighted to unveil the latest updates in Rising Mist, introducing exciting new features and improvements that will further immerse you in the enchanting world of Occoterra. Prepare to embark on grand adventures with the following enhancements:

[h3]🔮 Enhanced Ritual in Nama-Thalor:[/h3] Delve into the ancient traditions of Nama-Thalor with an improved and enriched ritual experience. Prepare to be captivated as the entire ritual, steeped in mysticism and lore, has been meticulously updated to bring you a truly awe-inspiring journey. Unleash the depths of your power and unlock the secrets that lie within tyou.

[h3]🌆 Expanded City of Nev Nen:[/h3] Venture into the city of Nev Nen, where we've added new activities and opportunities. Engage in new quests and uncover hidden secrets. Immerse yourself in the vibrant treetops as you explore and make your mark on Nev Nen's destiny.

[h3]⚔️ New Fighting Features:[/h3] Sharpen your blades and tighten your grip on your magical staff, as we've introduced thrilling new fighting features to enhance your combat experience. Prepare for exhilarating battles and show your adversaries the true power of a Rising Mist hero!

[h3]🔍 New Quests for Ebadin, Bamem, and Alira:[/h3] Explore the depths of Occoterra with brand new quests in the captivating given by Ebadin, Bamem, and Alira. Embark on thrilling storylines, encounter intriguing characters, and face formidable challenges. Uncover hidden secrets, earn valuable rewards, and make your mark on the ever-evolving world of Rising Mist as you play.

[h3]⚖️ Performance Re-balancing: [/h3] With this update we have fine-tuned the game's balance, ensuring a smooth and engaging experience for all players. With this performance re-balancing update, we've refined some gameplay mechanics, adjusted character abilities, and fine-tuned combat encounters. Prepare for a more satisfying and harmonious journey through the realms of Occoterra.

We're thrilled to bring you these exciting updates, enriching your exploration and deepening your connection to the immersive world of Rising Mist. Your unwavering support and invaluable feedback continue to shape the game, and we're committed to delivering the best experience possible.

[b]Also note that Rising Mist is now also available on Epic Store.[/b]

[b][h2]May the mists guide your path, and may your adventures in Rising Mist be legendary![/h2][/b]
Don't miss our upcoming game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/]Plague: London 1665[/url][/b]! 
Stay updated on its development progress by wishlisting it on Steam today!

Many thanks,
WASD Games

notes.title: Rising Mist Update: New Animations, Wind Effects, and More!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Rising Mist adventurers![/b]

We're thrilled to announce the latest update to our immersive adventure, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your journey through the mystical world of Occoterra. We've been hard at work and are excited to bring you the following enhancements:

[h3]💨 Wind Effects:[/h3] Feel the gentle breeze or the mighty gusts as we've introduced wind effects to most of the outdoor areas in the game. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere as the leaves rustle and grass sways in response to the whims of the wind. The dynamic wind effects will make your exploration of the world of Occoterra even more immersive and captivating.

[h3]💰 Store Adjustments: [/h3]We've listened to your feedback and made further adjustments to the prices in the stores across Occoterra. Whether you're seeking powerful weapons, valuable items, various seeds, or essential provisions, you'll find more reasonable prices that better reflect the value of your hard-earned gold. Get ready to gear up and make smart purchasing decisions as you embark on your epic adventure.

[h3]🎬 New Animations:[/h3] A wide range of new and captivating new animations was added! We've added a variety of fluid animations to bring even more depth to your character's interactions. Watch as your hero seamlessly engages in combat, and explores the stunning landscapes of Occoterra.

[h3] 🐉 Introducing a Majestic New Dragon:[/h3] Prepare for an epic encounter as we unleash a majestic new dragon into the game, adding a thrilling element to your adventures and a surprise that it has in store for you.

We hope these additions will bring new excitement and depth to your gameplay experience. Your continued support and feedback have been invaluable to us.

Stay tuned for more thrilling updates and exciting surprises on your journey through Rising Mist. 

[b][h2]May your path be filled with epic battles, wondrous discoveries, and unforgettable adventures![/h2][/b]

notes.title: Game update and a bug fix
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

we just update the current version from 1.0.8.0. to 1.0.9.0.
[h3]Update:[/h3]
- We updated the final ceremony in Nama-Thalor giving it more content with Ogun. 
- The prices in the Desert Camp (once unlocked) have also been updated in the easy mode, to make in more rewarding for adventures to trade with the desert camp.
- The Island of Nev Nen (once unlocked) has also received a content update connecting the last bit of the story.

[h3]Bug:[/h3]
- This update fixes a bug that allowed players to process other processable items besides Corn and Wheat, resulting in getting the Miller broken and rendering it unusable.
- Furthermore, this updates fix this same bug if you had it saved in any save slot, so players can resume a save game and this update should rectify it automatically.

Many thanks,
WASD Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1514610/Rising_Mist/

notes.title: Fighting update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

we just update the current version from 1.0.1.0. to 1.0.2.0.
it is a patch that give the players with level 1 shields and sword stronger hit ratios. Therefore now every seccesfull hit that you land with level 1 shield or sowrds dealts segnificently more damage to your opponent then before.
These are the effected changes in this version:
[list]
[*] Stronger Hit ratios - Every seccesfull hit that you land with level 1 shield or sowrds dealts segnificently more damage,
[*] Item drops - Items dropping from opponents when you defend them is more common now,
[*] Crystal Bay - Aphara requires less Chest's with weapons, then before - In Easy Mode,
[*] Potion Brewing - Less ingredients are required for the Anti Spell Potion.
[/list]

Many thanks,
WASD Games

notes.title: Less than 1 month to release - Please share
notes.notes:
[h1]Short update and a reminder[/h1]

[b]Reminder:[/b]
Wanted to remind you all that Rising Mist is less than a month shy of its release date and we are thrilled!
Most of the work is done and for the past weeks we have mainly focused on testing.

[b]Finishing testing:[/b]
As Rising Mist is all about the story and the experience, we had to replay the game many (many) times in order to be certain that the entire story lines up correctly and everything works.
More and more it became clear that Rising Mist is a completely story driven, visual novel/RPG and we are excited to hear your feedback after the release.

[b]Want to Help? Share - Please:[/b]
Please note if you have a gaming channel (YouTube, Twitch, Twitter, FB... or anything related to gaming) and would want to feature Rising Mist, we would be utterly grateful to you... or just please share this post, amongst your community or friends, this would also help us (if you like Rising Mist ocfurse).

[b]Curators (?):[/b]
Shout out to any curators. If you are interested in trying the game before the release, let us know:
contact[at]wasd-sw[dot]com

[b]Looking forward to the 24. February 2022.[/b]
Thank you for reading.
